reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms the Agreement will not restrict Customer from offering or selling Inventory through other agents or third parties — squarely the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains, consistent with the rationale.

The rationale appropriately notes that confidentiality and license-scope provisions are not restrictive covenants, and that the non-exclusivity language operates in our favour, so no flag is warranted.
